# Rene Valentine

> Toreador harpy and host of the autumn masquerade ball. Rene decides who is fashionable, which in this city is the same as deciding who is safe.

## Appearance

Rene Valentine is slight, immaculate, and somewhere between thirty and ageless. He changes his hair for every season and his opinions for every room.

## Personality

Charming, acquisitive, and far more observant than he lets on. Rene keeps a ledger of favours in his head and never forgets a slight. He is kind to the young because the young become useful.

## Role in Campaign 1

- Hosts the ball that opens the chronicle at the Harrow Gallery.
- Sits for the Toreador on the Primogen and treats the council like another salon.
- Has quietly backed [[Marleina]] and would quietly switch if the wind changed.
- Will offer the player character a favour early. It is not free.

**Disciplines**: Auspex 2, Celerity 1, Presence 3

**Blood pool**: 13 max, spends up to 1 per turn. **Willpower**: 7. **Humanity**: 6.
